Are you sure it replaced the previous installation? Otherwise just run from source (git clone, then "go run -tags preset_minimal,bls_off . sub_command blablabla") i am not sure i deleted zcli and then ran that command above and it appears not to have created the binary When no preset is specified it can't find a preset file in the presets package, and you get that error trying from source ``` ➜ zcli git:(master) go run -tags preset_minimal -tags bls_off transition blocks --pre /tmp/beacon_state_2876.ssz --post /dev/null /tmp/failed_beacon_block_2879.ssz package transition: unknown import path "transition": cannot find module providing package transition ``` No, fix the tags format.
